# Kianna Lim - Information Technology Student & Web Developer Portfolio

> Official portfolio of Kianna Ivan Marie Lim, a Bachelor of Science in Information Technology (BSIT) student at Data Center College of the Philippines in Baguio City. Specializing in front-end web development, responsive user interface design, database systems (MySQL, PHP), and software programming (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Java, C#, Python).

## Core Links

- [Portfolio Homepage](https://kanglimchu.netlify.app/): Main portfolio site featuring interactive project showcases, technical skills, and background.
- [GitHub Profile](https://github.com/kanglimchu-create): Source code repositories, academic assignments, and personal web projects.
- [Portfolio Source Code](https://github.com/kanglimchu-create/portfolio): Open-source repository for Kianna's personal portfolio website.

## Featured Projects

- [Beyond the Brew POS & MIS](https://kanglimchu.netlify.app/#projects): Coffee shop Point of Sale and Management Information System designed for transaction organization and inventory management.
- [Computer Rental & Sales System](https://kanglimchu.netlify.app/#projects): Relational database-backed tracking application developed with PHP, MySQL, and WampServer.
- [Personal Portfolio Website](https://github.com/kanglimchu-create/portfolio): Fast, responsive, accessible portfolio site built with semantic HTML5, modern CSS3 animations, and vanilla JavaScript. Live at [kanglimchu.netlify.app](https://kanglimchu.netlify.app/).

## Technical Skills

- **Front-End Development**: HTML5, CSS3 (Flexbox, Grid, CSS Variables), JavaScript (ES6+, DOM Manipulation, IntersectionObserver).
- **Programming & Scripting**: Java, C#, Python, PHP.
- **Databases & Systems**: MySQL, Relational Database Design, WampServer, System Analysis & Design.
- **Design & UI**: Responsive Web Design, Visual Hierarchy, Usability & Accessibility.

- **Institution**: Data Center College of the Philippines – Baguio City
- **Degree**: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology (BSIT)
